summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks the Bun binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunBinary, ['math_init.js'], {stdio:'inherit'})`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with control-flow and string-array obfuscation (rotating string-array helper `WV8StW`, hex-name identifiers, ~1000-entry mixed constant array). The obfuscated bundle is not imported by `dist/index.js` and has no relationship to the advertised React IoC / inversify wrapper functionality of the package. Executing this payload through a freshly downloaded alternate JS runtime evades Node-based scanners and sandboxes and runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
